cli.desc.main: Dropwheel: a radial wheel of file actions for Hyprland. Press Shift while dragging files to convert, compress, crop, redact or share them.
cli.epilog.main:
Examples:
  dropwheel start                          start the wheel (Quickshell shell)
  dropwheel open photo.jpg                 show the wheel for a file
  dropwheel run image.compress.balanced photo.jpg
  dropwheel doctor                         check dependencies

"dropwheel COMMAND --help" shows the options of a command.
cli.epilog.open: Without files the wheel opens under the pointer with the files in the clipboard (or as an empty drop target).
cli.epilog.run:
Examples:
  dropwheel run image.convert.png photo.heic
  dropwheel run image.resize.custom -p width=1200 *.jpg
  dropwheel run pdf.compress --json document.pdf

ACTION is an action id (see "dropwheel actions") or a group id, which runs the group's default action.
cli.epilog.setup:
hyprland copies dropwheel.lua into ~/.config/caelestia/ and adds require("dropwheel") to hypr-user.lua (with a backup).
thunar only shows the action unless --apply is given, because Caelestia manages ~/.config/Thunar/uca.xml.

cli.help.undo: undo a job: its outputs go to the trash (the last job by default)

cli.help.shares: list or stop the active LAN shares
cli.help.daemon: the service that talks to the shell (started by the shell itself)

cli.arg.no_wait: do not wait until the shell answers
cli.arg.run_json: print the final job event as JSON

cli.arg.action: action id (e.g. image.compress.balanced) or group id
